items.title: Bots in Kiro Crew (One point of contact for ongoing work) | Kiro: Zero to Hero 12
items.summary: How bots work in Kiro Crew 0.12. A bot is a single point of contact that has a name, a goal, its own memory, and worker sessions, so you only make the decisions. The deck follows a News bot that checks AWS and Kiro news every morning: the goal card, a 9:00 schedule, worker sessions, corrections, and a dashboard page. It also covers tools, permissions, memory, and models per bot, with an appendix on Ultra Mode, export, and the CLI. The screens are from Kiro Crew 0.12.0rc10, a pre-release build, on EC2. As of Kiro Crew 0.12.0. This is deck 12, in the Let it run part of the Kiro: Zero to Hero series.

items.title: Intro to Kiro Crew (Work that keeps going when you step away) | Kiro: Zero to Hero 11
items.summary: An introduction to Kiro Crew 0.12, the open-source app that keeps work going when you step away. It covers when to pick Crew over the Kiro IDE or CLI, the screen, scheduled jobs, PR watches, bots, and memory. It also covers the eight checks on tool calls that go through Crew, steering and hooks, MCP and Knowledge, the browser, other desktop apps (Computer Use), Slack, and running Crew on EC2 through an SSH or SSM tunnel. Most screens are from Kiro Crew 0.12.0rc10, a pre-release build, on EC2. As of Kiro Crew 0.12.0. This is deck 11, in the Let it run part of the Kiro: Zero to Hero series.

items.title: Hand off long tasks (Workflows, cloud sessions, Kiro Web) | Kiro: Zero to Hero 10
items.summary: How to hand long tasks to Kiro and check what comes back. Split work into steps with Workflows and approve the plan, keep work going in cloud sessions and Kiro Web with your laptop closed, start and fix work from GitHub issues and pull-request comments, schedule prompts, and configure the sandbox. Includes a real workflow run on a sample app (requirements, code, two parallel reviews, and a final check). As of November 2026 (Kiro IDE 1.4, Kiro CLI 3.1). This is deck 10, in the Let it run part of the Kiro: Zero to Hero series.
